content: Zendesk publishes no DOM contract for the agent-view ticket table: no documented data-test-id, class or attribute scheme, and no stability guarantee. Zendesk's own extensibility story is the ZAF SDK (apps in iframes), not DOM access. Prior art on the Chrome Web Store: 'Zendesk Priority Highlights' (87 users, 3.71/5, last updated 2019-07-21, delisted 2026-08-27 for a minor policy violation plus missing privacy policy) with reviews reading 'It no longer works', 'It's currently not working', 'This is working again for me', and a user note that the view must have the priority column; 'Zest - The Zendesk Colour Coder' (2.6/5) broke on Chrome 105. Zendesk agent UI is localised into 40 languages plus 4 variants (incl. German, Japanese, Portuguese-BR), selected per agent independently of account languages. Zendesk Support dark mode shipped: account-level setting 'activated by default', each agent opts in via profile > Appearance (dark / light / match system), covers tickets and views.
